name: personal-growth-copilot
description: One explicit-invocation agent skill for personal growth, relationships, leadership, rehearsal and source-grounded learning.

interface.longDescription: A portable user-directed agent skill combining reflection, growth experiments, everyday and workplace relationships, consent-aware relationship decisions, leadership methods, rehearsal and source-grounded learning. Explicit invocation; session-only by default. Production and host qualification remain separate.
defaultPrompt: Help me understand a recurring pattern.
Turn a goal into a small growth experiment.
Review what I learned from a recent setback.
Help me learn a topic through source-grounded practice.
Help me prepare a difficult family conversation.
Teach me delegation and rehearse it one turn at a time.
Help me clarify relationship expectations without assuming agreement.
